q: Where do the rate limit counters live since the Redis move?

results.text: Per-client rate-limit counters live in Redis with a 60-second TTL.
Redis moved to the dedicated cache cluster at redis://cache-cluster.internal:6379.
Authorization is enforced by the policy engine; the identity module (renamed from auth) reads its configuration from identity.yaml.
The production deploy window is Tuesdays at 14:00 UTC since May.
The p99 latency budget for the gateway is 250 milliseconds.
The admin API is mounted under /_admin and requires the internal bearer token.
The protocol buffer schema lives at proto/gateway.proto.
The feature-flags service endpoint is http://flags.corp:7071 after the service mesh migration.
Import statements are kept sorted alphabetically, enforced by the ESLint import/order rule.
Rate limiting is 100 requests per minute per client id, enforced at the router layer.
